7. [IARC.10.1.7] Declare the `.c` file in `libds.build`, the
   one source of libds's build. A file directly under
   `runtime/src/libds/`, or under its `rete/` or `series/`, is compiled
   by that directory's glob; a file under `dsc/` needs a row in the
   `Obj` table, and a top-level file whose include flags differ from
   the default a row in the `IFlags` table.
   `runtime/src/libds/Makefile` is generated from `libds.build`
   and is not edited.
